messages.subject: [Resolved] Service Outage
parts:
ShinyApps Users,

This morning's outage that affected application loading and deploying/terminating of applications has been resolved. We have corrected the problem so things should be back to normal. Please report any other issues that you see.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and thanks for using ShinyApps.

-Andy

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Re: [Resolved] Service Outage
parts:
Thanks for the update.  I have an app that is still on spark at: http://spark.rstudio.com/johnpaul/Water/ 

Yesterday at around the same time that shinyapps.io went down it stated giving me this message:

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in library(lattice) : there is no package called ‘lattice’ Calls: runApp ... eval -> source -> withVisible -> eval -> eval -> library Execution halted

 The app has worked fine for many months and has had not recent updates - could this be a related issue?

Thanks.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: [Resolved] Service Outage
parts:
John,

spark and ShinyApps are unrelated services, so this issue is not related. FWIW, spark is deprecated server that will be shutdown in the future. Is there a reason you could not move your application to ShinyApps?

-Andy
